flash_sale.description: Flash deal with countdown timer, highest visibility
flash_sale.extra_platform_fee: platform.flash_sale_extra_fee applies on top of regular fee

notes: If regular_price > competitor_ceiling, cap at competitor_ceiling and recalculate actual_margin.
If floor_price_check fails for flash_sale, downgrade to platform_voucher; if still fails, downgrade to normal_promo; if still fails, best_promo_tier = none.
Best promo tier = highest discount tier that passes floor_price_check AND meets eligibility.
For flash_sale floor check, use total_fee = commission + transaction_fee + flash_sale_extra_fee.
For voucher/normal_promo floor check, use total_fee = commission + transaction_fee (no extra fee).

allocation_output_rules: Allocation cost uses the warehouse-specific landed cost for units from each warehouse.
Total promo budget cap: 800000 THB (sum of all allocation_cost_thb across all platform-SKU combos).
If total exceeds budget, iteratively remove the platform-SKU combo with the lowest effective promo margin until budget is met.
Effective promo margin = (best_promo_price × (1 - total_platform_fee_for_that_tier) - landed_cost) / best_promo_price.
Remove whole combos, not partial units. After removal, set that combo's allocation to 0 and mark as skipped.
